verdict.rationale: Asking whether a mobile developer client offers in-app terminal editing and lint checks is a fair question, but the evidence for GitHub Mobile covers only reviewing PRs, code search, browsing, and Copilot agent tasks, with no terminal editor or syntax/lint checker. GitHub CLI and Copilot CLI are separate terminal products and do not count, and community feedback describes the app as not really a git client.

support.subject: As a developer, I can edit files with a terminal-based editor and run syntax/lint checkers inside the app
